name: flash_encryption
description: flash_encryption, unmodified, built with flash encryption in Development mode (the user's menuconfig choice) and flashed in plaintext on a new chip: the bootloader generates a key, burns it into BLOCK_KEY0 with the XTS_AES_128_KEY purpose, encrypts the bootloader, the partition table and the encrypted partitions in place through manual encryption, burns SPI_BOOT_CRYPT_CNT and resets; the ROM, the bootloader and the application then run from the encrypted flash through the cache's decryption. The application's partition reads give plaintext and its raw flash reads ciphertext; FATFS works on both FAT partitions, the test string found in the plain one and not in the encrypted one; NVS is encrypted under keys it generates.
